Author: Sadonia (Velvet Systems)
Name: Eorzea Milkers
Punchline: (Work in progress) An 18+ dairy life game: be the cow, the farmer or the owner, and run a dairy with friends.
Description:
WORK IN PROGRESS: Eorzea Milkers is still growing. Expect balance changes and new features in updates.

Eorzea Milkers is a dairy life game you play with friends. Be a cow, a bull, a farmer, the owner of your own dairy, or any mix.

- Cows make milk while they play. Drink, rest, have treats and get fed by your farmers for faster milk, then get milked at a stall or by a farmer's hand
- Bulls make seed and get milked too, and breed their dairy's cows through the Corruption plugin, with bred bonuses and pregnancies
- You're paid for reaching your daily quota (set by your farmer or owner), more for higher grades (C up to S+). Higher grades also milk faster
- Farmers feed the herd from the dairy's feed bin, hand milk, groom cows, clean stalls, fill jugs from the dairy tank and bake for the dairy shelf
- Deliver milk to customer orders, other dairies' buy orders and the Grand Creamery's weekly contract
- Set up your dairy anywhere, with a private place at home for members, stalls to upgrade and a shared fund for feed, stalls and the Velvet pump
- Upgrades come free as you level
- Levels to 100 for every role, daily goals, awards, and dairies that level up together

Adults only (18+); Lalafell characters can't play. Nothing is ever said in public chat, and it never moves your character. Lifestream is optional, for one-click travel to public dairies.
